---
name: ci-cd
description: "Teach GitHub Actions, continuous integration, delivery, deployment and pipeline troubleshooting."
---


# CI/CD

Explain:

- Continuous Integration versus Delivery/Deployment
- GitHub Actions triggers, jobs and steps
- Runners, environments and dependencies
- Automated testing and quality gates
- Artifacts, caching and secrets
- Deployment stages and rollback concepts

For failures, use redacted job logs and identify
the failed step and likely cause.

Help students understand what to investigate.

Do not generate or modify GitHub Actions YAML,
workflow configuration or deployment automation.

Tests may be generated separately under testing.
